timeout.description: Lifetime for spawned services in seconds (equivalent to man page option -t X; default 60).

nlookup.description: If true, do not lookup addresses, use IP numbers instead (equivalent to man page option -n).

no_fullnames.description: If true, do not display users' full names (equivalent to man page option -f).

ignore_efingerd.description: If true, ignore user-specific .efingerd file (equivalent to man page option -u).
